question: Which of the following is ‘NOT’ a feature of organic farming?

options.text: Minimal or no use of chemicals

solution:
The correct answer is__** No use of mixed cropping.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Organic farming** is a method of **agriculture **that involves the cultivation of crops without the use of **synthetic fertilizers, pesticides, **or** genetically modified organisms (GMOs).**
 
• It is a sustainable and environmentally friend
